title: Harbor Bank — renewal risk
description: Existing prospect evaluating switch. Competitive rip-and-replace conversation with timeline pressure.

transcript.speaker: Rep
transcript.text: Your Fireflies renewal is in six weeks — what's driving the look elsewhere?

transcript.speaker: Prospect
transcript.text: Summaries are generic. Leadership wants objections and next steps with proof.

transcript.speaker: Rep
transcript.text: That's our wedge: every bullet cites the exact line so managers can audit in seconds.

transcript.speaker: Prospect
transcript.text: We're worried about migration pain. Can you ingest our last ninety days of calls?

transcript.speaker: Rep
transcript.text: Yes — bulk upload plus URL ingest. We can backfill a pilot cohort in a weekend.

transcript.speaker: Prospect
transcript.text: If we switch, legal needs the export formats in Markdown and JSON for archive.

transcript.speaker: Rep
transcript.text: Both are built in. I'll include sample exports in today's follow-up.

transcript.speaker: Prospect
transcript.text: Next step: internal bake-off next Tuesday with two recorded calls side by side.

transcript.speaker: Rep
transcript.text: I'll join the bake-off and prep a Gong-style comparison sheet with price and features.

transcript.speaker: Prospect
transcript.text: Intent is to cancel the Fireflies renewal if the bake-off is a clear win.

followUpEmail.subject: Harbor bake-off pack — exports + Gong comparison
followUpEmail.body:
Team —

Thanks for the renewal conversation.

Attaching today's follow-up pack:
1) Sample Markdown + JSON exports for legal archive
2) Gong-style comparison sheet (features + price)
3) Plan to backfill ~90 days via bulk upload / URL ingest over a weekend

I'll join Tuesday's bake-off with two recorded calls side by side.

If we win clearly, you said you'd cancel the Fireflies renewal.

— OpenGong Lite
